registry_name: Municipal Inspection Verification Demo Sources Registry
description: Catalog of public, derived, and synthetic data sources used to calibrate and demonstrate multimodal evidence fusion for municipal road repair verification.
provenance_policy: All data sources are strictly categorized by data_origin ('public', 'derived', or 'synthetic'). No synthetic record is misrepresented as an authentic government voucher.

sources.source_name: Road Damage Dataset 2020 (RDD2020 / Crowdsensing Road Damage)
sources.publisher: Sekilab / University of Tokyo (Arya, D., Maeda, H., Ghosh, S. K., Toshniwal, D., Mraz, A., Kashiyama, T., & Sekimoto, Y.)
sources.citation: Arya et al., 'Transfer Learning-based Road Damage Detection using High-Resolution Smartphone Images', IEEE BigData 2020 / Mendeley Data, doi:10.17632/5ty2wb6gvg.1
sources.domain: Pothole detection, road cavity analysis, longitudinal cracks, alligator cracking
sources.usage_in_project: Reference visual features, crack geometry, cavity dimensions (depth/diameter benchmarks), and roughness statistics used by the OpenCV Computer Vision pipeline.

sources.source_name: Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike (BBMP) Fix My Street Civic Grievance Dataset
sources.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) / CC BY 4.0
sources.domain: Municipal citizen grievance records, road defect complaints, ward designations, administrative resolution states
sources.usage_in_project: Complaint phrasing, citizen vocabulary ('huge dangerous pothole', 'bike accidents', 'no work done'), complaint ticket IDs, and ward naming conventions.

sources.source_name: Central Public Procurement Portal (CPPP) & Public Works Department (PWD) Works Completion Records
sources.publisher: National Informatics Centre (NIC) / Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs (MoHUA), Government of India
sources.license: Government Open Data License - India (GODL) / Public Records
sources.domain: Municipal contractor work completion certificates, engineer inspection sign-offs, defect liability clauses, work order identifiers
sources.usage_in_project: Schema and structural layout for official PDF vouchers (e.g. Work Order IDs, Executive Engineer stamps, contractor names, completion statements, certification dates).

sources.domain: Citizen IVR helpline voice complaints with harmonic pitch simulation and synchronized transcripts
sources.usage_in_project: Simulates citizen voice calls reporting ongoing road damage with timestamps, persistence cues, and location tags, processed by faster-whisper STT.

sources.source_name: Deterministic Asphalt Surface & Defect Texture Synthesizer
sources.domain: Ground-truth road surface images featuring calibrated pothole cavities (45cm depth, high roughness) vs smooth resurfaced Grade-1 bitumen
sources.usage_in_project: Enables 100% offline, deterministic OpenCV edge and contour extraction with ground-truth verification and OCR stencils.
